tags.name: ITLoadKW

tags.name: TotalFacilityKW

tags.name: CapacityKW

tags.name: OutdoorTempC

tags.name: ColdAisleAvgC

tags.name: ActiveAlarms

tags.name: Available

tags.name: StartCountdownS

tags.documentation: Master switch for the dc_sim timer.

tags.documentation: Progress marker of the running scenario (see README).

tags.documentation: Simulated seconds per real second; all time constants scale with it.

tags.documentation: CRAH unit (1-4) forced into FAULT; 0 = none.

tags.documentation: Last timer error; cleared after 30 clean ticks.

tags.documentation: Epoch time of the previous tick (for dt).

tags.name: OkStreak

tags.name: ScenarioClock

tags.name: UtilityStableS
tags.documentation: Seconds the utility has been back (re-transfer timer).

tags.name: MechPowerS
tags.documentation: Seconds the mechanical bus (chillers, CRAH) has had power.
